WITH ordered AS (
                    SELECT
                        run_id,
                        deal_id,
                        piece_index,
                        piece_cid,
                        url_tested,
                        success,
                        content_length,
                        is_valid_car,
                        result_code,
                        tested_at,
                        manifest_snapshot_id,
                        file_size_bytes,
                        observed_size_bytes,
                        size_matched,
                        manifest_response_time_ms,
                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                            PARTITION BY piece_index
                            ORDER BY url_tested ASC
                        ) AS url_ordinal
                    FROM
                        deal_sli_piece_results
                    WHERE
                        deal_id = $1
                        AND run_id = $2
                )
                SELECT
                    run_id,
                    deal_id,
                    piece_index,
                    piece_cid,
                    url_tested,
                    success,
                    content_length,
                    is_valid_car,
                    result_code AS "result_code: ResultCode",
                    tested_at,
                    manifest_snapshot_id,
                    file_size_bytes,
                    observed_size_bytes,
                    size_matched,
                    manifest_response_time_ms,
                    url_ordinal AS "url_ordinal!"
               FROM
                    ordered
               WHERE
                    $3::integer IS NULL
                    OR (piece_index, url_ordinal) > ($3, $4)
               ORDER BY
                    piece_index ASC,
                    url_ordinal ASC
               LIMIT $5
